buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to

increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 3. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 4. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 5. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 6. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 7. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 8. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 9. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Earnest Money Deposit (EMD): Copy of the EMD receipt shall be submitted along with the bid. EMD exemption shall be applicable only to bidders eligible for exemption as per the prevailing GeM General Terms and Conditions (GTC). 2. Udyam Registration / Startup Certificate:

Copy of the valid Udyam Registration Certificate and/or Startup Certificate shall be submitted by the bidder, wherever exemption from experience, turnover, EMD or any other eligibility criteria is being claimed. 3. Undertaking under Rule 144(xi) of GFRs, 2017: Self-certification/undertaking on the bidder's official company letterhead confirming compliance with t he restrictions stipulated under Rule 144(xi) of the General Financial Rules (GFRs), 2017, including th e applicable provisions relating to land-border sharing countries. 4. Local Content Declaration – Make in India: A duly signed and stamped declaration regarding the percentage of local content in the offered produc t, confirming compliance with the applicable provisions of the Government of India’s Public Procuremen t (Preference to Make in India) Order, as amended from time to time. 5. Tender Acceptance Certificate: Duly signed and stamped undertaking on the bidder's official letterhead confirming unconditional accept ance of all terms and conditions, specifications, scope of supply, delivery requirements and other provisi ons of the tender. 6. Manufacturer’s Authorization / OEM Authorization: Manufacturer’s Authorization Form (MAF) / OEM Authorization shall be submitted wherever applicable. The a uthorization shall clearly mention the GeM Bid Number, Make and Model of the offered product and shall be duly signed and stamped by the authorized representative of the OEM. 7. GST and PAN Documents: Copy of the bidder’s valid GST Registration Certificate and PAN Card shall be submitted. 8. Income Tax Returns: Copies of the bidder’s Income Tax Returns (ITRs) for the last three consecutive AssessmentY ears shall be submitted. 9. Fall Clause Undertaking: Duly signed and stamped undertaking on the bidder’s official company letterhead confirming complianc e with the applicable Fall Clause provisions and certifying that the bidder shall abide by the same during the validity/execution period of the contract. 10. Non-Blacklisting / Litigation Undertaking: Duly signed and stamped undertaking on Affdavit confirming thatt he firm has not been blacklisted, de barred or banned by any Government Department, PSU, Government Agency or Private Organization an d that no vigilance, FEMA or court case is pending against the firm which may adversely affect its eligib ility or performance under the tender. 11. Experience Certificate: The bidder or the OEM of the product offered in the bid, either directly or through its authorized reseller(s ), should have regularly manufactured and supplied the same or similar category of products to any Central Go

vernment / State Government Organization / PSU during the last three financial years preceding the bid open ing date. Copies of relevant purchase/work orders/contracts along with delivery and acceptance documents,s uch as CRAC (Consignee Receipt and Acceptance Certificate) or GeM Contract, shall be submitted as evidence of h aving supplied the required quantity during each applicable financial year. 12. Satisfactory Past Performance Certificate: A satisfactory past performance certificate against the experience documents submitted by the bidder/ OEM shall be provided from the concerned organization/consignee, wherever applicable. 13. Bidder’s Annual Turnover: Annual turnover details of the bidder for the last three consecutive financial years, duly certified by a Char tered Accountant (CA) / Cost Accountant, shall be submitted along with the bid. 14. OEM’s Annual Turnover: Annual turnover details of the OEM for the last three consecutive financial years, duly certified by a Charter ed Accountant (CA) / Cost Accountant, shall be submitted along with the bid. 15. Bank Mandate Form: Duly filled, signed and stamped Bank Mandate Form certified/endorsed by the bidder’s bank shal lbe submitted. 16. Product Brochure / Catalogue: Technical/product brochure or catalogue of the quoted product shall be submitted, clearly indicating the Ma ke and Model of the offered item. The details in the brochure/catalogue should be sufficient to establish com pliance with the tender specifications. 17. Technical Compliance Sheet: A duly signed and stamped Technical Specifications-wise Compliance Sheet shall be submitted, clearly in dicating compliance against each individual technical requirement/specification mentioned in the tender. 18. Malicious Code Certificate: A duly signed and stamped Malicious Code / Malware-Free Certificate shall be submitted wherever appli cable, confirming that the supplied product/system/software is free from malicious code, malware, virus , spyware or any other harmful code. 19. Comprehensive Warranty and Post-Warranty CAMC Undertaking: Undertaking on the bidder’s official company letterhead confirming provision of comprehensive warranty as specified in the tender and willingness/commitment to provide post-warranty Comprehensive Annual Mainte nance Contract (CAMC), wherever applicable and as per tenderr equirements. 20. Other Required Certifications: All other certificates, test reports, declarations, undertakings, compliance documents andc ertifications specifically required under the uploaded technical specifications, drawings, schedules and tender docum ents shall be submitted along with the bid.

21. Tax Compliance The bidder must upload an updated income tax return for the last three years, and GSTR 3B documents for the last three months. 22. Technical Compliance: All technical specifications must strictly match the submitted data she et. Any deviation may lead to disqualification of the bidder. Note:- For High - End Laptop, minimum RAM sholud be 32 GB and expendable upto 64 GB .
